our_interpretation: The first clause is an expressly tentative judgment, not a categorical assertion that machines lack clinical understanding.
A possible functional reading concerns integrating images, patient history, notes, and clinical management. That is an evaluator interpretation, not a supplied definition of 'big picture'.
The second clause suggests a relative strength, but names neither systems nor comparable measures for vision and case-file understanding.
The intended temporal scope is radiology AI at publication in October 2023.
criteria.support_condition: No categorical support condition fairly captures the combined statement. Matched clinical evaluations could support the proposed functional reading, but would not convert the expressed uncertainty into a firm claim.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No categorical contradiction condition applies without defining systems and tasks. Success on a text examination alone would not establish human-level integrated clinical understanding.
